# DeepSeek Dock
**English** · Simplified Chinese
**A persistent, customizable left Dock and a Codex-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness.**
Pin important chats across workspaces, draft on Home without creating a chat until you send, and pre
view videos in the right file panel beside the conversation. DeepSeek Dock installs independently wi
thout modifying the host application, preserving DeepSeek branding and native tools.
`0.2.0` · Supported hosts: **macOS / Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 or 0.2.2-rc.1** · Third-party community plug

## See it in action
**Watch the full 45-second demo with music** · Watch in Chinese · Static preview
The 45-second loop follows the 0.2.0 application Dock, All Apps, pinning/reordering, global search,
completion inbox, Back/Forward and existing file/video tools. Click it for the version with music. B
oth formats use illustrative UI based on the current code and fictional sample data; they are not li
ve recordings or performance measurements.
## Features
| Feature | What changes in everyday use |
| **Application Dock and overview** | Open registered plugin pages through monochrome icons, pin and

reorder them, or find them in All Apps. Recent unpinned apps have their own section. |
| **Global s
earch** | Find chat titles, workspaces and quick actions in one palette; chat-body search is availab

le when the Host index is enabled. |
| **Session inbox** | Review completion excerpts and pending in

teractions. Home and the bell share an unread dot, and read completion records remain available. |
|

**Back and Forward** | Revisit global pages and existing chats visited in the current window. |
| *
*Codex-inspired UI** | Home, chats, plugins, and scheduled tasks share one window frame and draggabl
e top strip. Moving between pages keeps the same navigation and tool controls, with DeepSeek brandin

g and the native chat hierarchy. |
| **Cross-workspace pins** | Find important chats from different
workspaces in one pinned section. Each appears only once; unpinning returns it to its original group

without changing workspace membership. |
| **Draft-first Home** | Compose and revise before committ
ing to a chat. A chat is created only when you send, so unsent ideas do not fill the sidebar with em

pty entries. |
| **Video in the file panel** | Play and seek a generated video on the right while ch
ecking the conversation beside it. Reopening the tool drawer restores existing tabs so you can conti
nue reviewing the same content. |
## Install
Requires **macOS / Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 or 0.2.2-rc.1**. Disable the old `@local/chatgpt-rail` plugin
first if installed (migration). This package is not published to npm; use the repository URL below.
No manual build is needed. Install packages are also available from GitHub Releases; extract the ZIP
and select the complete folder containing `package.json`.

## Compatibility and limits
| Area | Current scope |
| **Host and platform** | Supported host versions are `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-rc.1` on macOS. The or
iginal feature baseline was validated on `0.2.1-rc.5`; the `0.2.2-rc.1` upgrade check covers install
ation, loading, Dock collapse/customization, drafts, page navigation, and tool-drawer controls. The
0.2.0 additions were checked with light/dark themes on `0.2.2-rc.1`; other systems, the additions on

the older host, and very narrow windows have not had a complete on-device acceptance pass. |
| **Vi
deo codecs** | Recognizing an extension does not guarantee that every codec decodes. Support depends
on the system/browser; H.264/AAC MP4 has been tested. Unsupported files can open in a system applic

ation. |
| **Desktop video size** | Desktop reads a complete temporary Blob before playback. Cached
and in-flight media bytes share a **256 MiB** budget, with external opening available above it. This

is not a process peak-memory cap. |
| **Playback position** | Restoration is limited to the same to

ol tab lifecycle and file version, not guaranteed after an app restart. |
| **Drafts and voice** | A
ttachments do not survive refresh. Voice requires the host component and local recognition resources

. `/` commands and `@` suggestions depend on host catalogs and permissions. |
| **Language** | The R
EADME is bilingual. Some added interface copy is still Chinese; full UI localization is not complete
ME is bilingual. Some added interface copy is still Chinese; full UI localization is not complete. |
Version `0.2.0` remains an early `0.x` release. Compatibility is explicitly limited to the two host
versions above; a newer Harness release needs renewed validation.
Hiding pinned chats can reduce the visible row count on a native group's first page. Expand the grou
p to see more. The plugin uses host slots, services, and some DOM structure; host upgrades require r
enewed validation and are not automatically compatible.
